decision.rule: §7 - if a conservative full-31 estimate exceeds $20.00, make ZERO new calls and return F7B_3_COST_BOUND_BEFORE_START
decision.independentBlocker: The conservative estimate also exceeds the gateway balance, so raising the cap alone would not guarantee completion: the account holds $23.74 and the conservative bound is $26.84.
decision.alsoNote: Even the worst observed rate with NO variance margin ($21.47) exceeds the $20.00 cap, so the bound does not depend on the choice of margin.
decision.whyNotProceedAnyway: Central expectation is $14.4 to $16.9, so a run would probably finish. But §7 tests a conservative estimate, not the expectation, and starting a run that has a real chance of stopping at wave C would spend most of the cap and still leave the canary incomplete - the exact outcome §7 forbids.
